summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1 and verified persistence through a safe node restart. Existing contents and the legacy Ubuntu 16.04/kernel 4.4 platform were preserved.
actions_performed: Created the system group inventory-readers and nologin system user inventorysvc.
Set the complete inventory tree to inventorysvc:inventory-readers.
Applied directory mode 750 and file mode 640.
Verified owner and reader-group access, with unrelated users denied.
Restarted node1 safely and verified full recovery.

evidence.summary: The two file paths and SHA-256 hashes are identical before and after repair/restart.

evidence.requirement: Owned by inventorysvc and readable by inventory-readers
evidence.summary: Directories are inventorysvc:inventory-readers mode 750; files are mode 640. Direct tests prove owner and group-reader access.
A nobody:nogroup process was directly denied access before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic remained unchanged.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from b185f188-42be-40d1-84ea-f7c9a76f5c8d to a32b8f05-6649-4979-b014-2a6af5b14d99; SSH, identities, permissions, hashes, access policy, and systemd health recovered.
